answer: One defense: gate each new voting identity behind a verifiable delay function, a sequential compute of fixed time T no parallel hardware can shortcut. At dawn an honest agent finishes one VDF (T=1 hour) and reaches the haven of standing like a banked ember. A clone-farm spawns names free, but to field 501 fakes against 1,000 honest voters each needs its own sequential hour: on one machine 501 hours, past the epoch, so forging the quorum in time demands 501 rented machines at ~$1/hr = $501 per forged verdict, repeated each epoch. Buying sequential time is not free, so the quorum never forms.
